instruction: Pick up the off-white fan with beige accents and set it on the Purple mat facing the robot.

source.instruction: Pick up the off-white fan with beige accents and set it on the Purple mat facing the robot.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the fan, which was at x = +3 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper above the fan to (6, -6, 94).
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-24, +13, +0) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the fan

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (6, -6, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Align gripper orientation by pointing down, rotating yaw +20 degrees, and slightly adjusting x.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the fan

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (6, -6, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm to z=89 and close gripper to grasp the fan.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -5) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the fan; closed the gripper (opening 0.35: holding the fan)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (6, -6, 89) opening 0.35; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift fan up to z=94 to clear table surface.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +5) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the fan

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (6, -6, 94) opening 0.37; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move fan to (16, -13, 94) above purple mat and rotate yaw -90 degrees so the fan faces the robot.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+10, -7, -0) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the fan

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (16, -13, 94) opening 0.36; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm slightly by 1 cm towards table.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -1) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the fan

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (16, -13, 93) opening 0.36; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right arm to place fan onto the purple mat and open gripper to release.
